description: Traffic Flow Analysis for Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Planning in Namie Town, Japan is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors TUO ZHANG. This dataset and analysis framework provides a novel methodology for estimating electric vehicle (EV) travel patterns and charging availability using real-world traffic survey data from Japan. The project addresses a critical gap in EV infrastructure planning by developing data-driven approaches to understand when and where EVs are likely to need charging. Coverage: national (JP); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
